ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the attached figure, a six-membered ring skeleton can be seen, with two double bonds in the ring; the upper-left position of the ring is connected to a carbonyl oxygen, forming a carbonyl on the ring; the upper-right position of the ring is connected to another carbonyl, and the outside of this carbonyl is connected to a generic substituent R. H+ is also separately marked above the structure, and the curved arrows in the figure indicate mechanistic electron transfer; the problem requires ignoring these arrows. Then reasoning: The R on the right is represented as * as an unspecified connection end, so the external acyl group can be written as *C(=O)-; it is connected to the six-membered ring, and C1...1 is used to represent ring closure, the double bonds in the ring are written according to the figure as C=CC=CC, and the other carbonyl on the ring is written as C1=O; the separate proton is written as .[H+] as an independent component. Therefore the SMILES is *C(=O)C1C=CC=CC1=O.[H+].

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中是一个带两个羰基的六元环骨架，右侧羰基外接一个通用取代基 R，顶部还有一个单独标出的 H+；所有弯箭头只表示机理过程，题目要求忽略。再推理：把该骨架按 SMILES 书写，左侧未指明连接端用 * 表示，羰基写成 C(=O)，六元环用 C1...1 闭环表示，环上另一处羰基写成 =O，并把质子作为独立组分用 .[H+] 连接。得到 *C(=O)C1C=CC=CC1=O.[H+].
